text:
nina: Heads-up: planning unpin of runtime v2.15 from the staging quant-canary cohort tomorrow 03:00 UTC (change window 03:00-03:30). Goal: validate new kernel selection with redwood-llama3q-quant-v2 across EU/US zones. Required client SDK: 4.2.0+. Any objections?

deploybot: Snapshot: runtime:v2.15 pinned -> will be unpinned in cohort. model:redwood-llama3q-quant-v2 marked soft-pin. sdk:4.1.x will be blocked by gateway until upgrade. Planned command: `deploybot unpin --runtime v2.15 --cohort quant-canary --when 2026-03-25T03:00Z --zones eu,us`

harry: We're good from infra side but note: long-sequence tracer saw p95 regen on v2.15 in last run when KV-cache cold. Recommend warming pass and enabling kvcache-warmup=true for 30m before.

sophia: QA will run the warmup + perf smoke: `/ci/run canary-quant-warmup && /ci/check p95 < 200ms && /ci/check kv-hit > 95%`. If any check fails we pin back immediately.

deploybot: Preflight checklist updated:
- warmup job scheduled at 02:20 UTC (job 13477)
- smoke jobs 13478(latency), 13479(error-rate), 13480(kv-hit)
- alert thresholds: err_rate > 0.5% OR kv_hit < 90% OR p95 increase > 40% -> auto-pin.

nina: Clarification: fallback routing policy should send >16k token requests to runtime:v2.14 compat shim. Also, cross-region routing: if eu zone shows anomalies we'll route eu traffic to us runtime temporarily (via `routectl`).

infra: Also watch for SDK header mismatch: SDK 4.2.0 introduces `X-RW-Kernel` and `X-RW-Opt-Level`. Older SDKs will receive 422 for structured toolcalls. Gateway will log header-mismatch metrics under `gw.sdk.header_errors`.

sophia: DevRel confirmed Node/Go wheels are published. Python wheel will be cut at 01:45 UTC. I'll post the artifact links.

deploybot: Auto-pinning rule configured: if `gw.sdk.header_errors` > 100 in 5m AND err_rate > 0.2% -> `deploybot pin --runtime v2.15 --reason 'header-failures'`. Manual rollback command also: `deploybot pin --runtime v2.15 --reason 'canary regressions' && routectl set --cohort quant-canary --to runtime:v2.15`

opsbot: @oncall assigned harry for 03:00-04:00UTC monitoring. Notifications will go to #oncall-runtime and a PagerDuty escalation at 03:10 if auto-pin triggers.

harry: I'll monitor p95/err_rate/kv_hit and gateway header_errors. If any of the auto-pin conditions hit I'll execute pin command and notify here.

nina: Release note bullets (draft):
- Unpin runtime v2.15 for quant-canary to test kernel selection with quantized Llama3 variant
- SDK 4.2.0 required (adds X-RW-Kernel header); older clients may be blocked
- Fallback to runtime:v2.14 for long-sequence (>16k) requests
- Rollback: `deploybot pin` + `routectl set` to revert cohort
Please append any critical items.

sophia: Added link to release draft: https://go/release/332-unpin-v2-15-quant-canary-draft

harry: Preflight run results (from CI):
```
[13477] warmup OK  kv-hit 96%
[13478] p95 178ms (baseline 165ms)
[13479] err_rate 0.12%
[13480] header_errors 0
```
All green. Proceed at 03:00 if no last-minute blockers.

nina: Great. If nothing new by 02:40 UTC I will trigger the unpin. Keep this thread for rollback notes and postmortem anchors.

opsbot: Reminder: change window metadata attached to release: `change-window: 2026-03-25T03:00:00Z/2026-03-25T03:30:00Z`

sophia: Uploading python wheel now. Link: https://artifacts.redwood/pkgs/sdk/python/4.2.0

harry: Oncall sign-off: monitoring in place, auto-pin thresholds set. Will pin immediately if thresholds breach.

nina: Thanks team. I'll post final confirmation when unpin command runs.
